storylines.title: US-Ukraine rift over Starlink and strikes
storylines.summary: US limits on Starshield access and Trump's criticism of Ukraine's refinery strikes have strained ties; EU leaders backed Zelenskyy and Russia keeps hitting energy targets.

events.text: Zelenskyy says Starlink access not fully restored; reports say the White House ordered the limit; EU leaders rally behind Kyiv.
Trump calls Ukraine's latest strikes a 'disgrace' and says Zelenskyy is harder to work with than Putin.

storylines.title: AI debt worries and market selloff
storylines.summary: Chip stocks, banks and AI-linked borrowers such as CoreWeave are sliding this week as credit markets question the AI debt buildup.

events.text: Chip stocks near longest losing run since 2008; big bank shares on worst weekly streak since 2008.

storylines.title: Fed under Warsh weighs further hikes
storylines.summary: After a September hike, the Fed under Chairman Kevin Warsh is expected to hold Oct. 28, though inflation and his communication changes leave uncertainty.

events.text: Warsh says the economy has performed largely as expected since the September hike; markets expect a hold.

storylines.title: 2026 midterm elections
storylines.summary: Democrats lead in fundraising and forecast shifts, Republicans lean on Musk money, and legal fights over voter rolls continue ahead of Nov. 3.

events.text: Cook Political Report moves 11 House races toward Democrats; Talarico's haul tops Senate GOP rivals.
Musk gave a record $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund.
